get-v1-apps.title: List apps
get-v1-apps.summary: Find apps by bundle ID, name, or SKU. Get plain app objects with a cursor for the next page.
notes: Use bundleId for an exact bundle-identifier match. Name and SKU filters use Apple’s supported matching behavior.
Versions, builds, and localizations have their own GET routes. This request does not silently load an app’s resource graph.

get-v1-apps-_id_-builds.title: List an app’s builds
get-v1-apps-_id_-builds.summary: Read builds for one app. Filter by processing state and follow a cursor to retrieve additional builds.
notes: processingState describes build processing. It does not indicate App Review approval or whether a version is live.
The adapter uses Apple’s app-build endpoint for an unfiltered list. Filtering uses GET /v1/builds with filter[app] fixed to appId, so filters apply across the collection rather than to one page.

get-v1-appstoreversionlocalizations-_id_.title: Read a version localization
get-v1-appstoreversionlocalizations-_id_.summary: Read the store listing for an exact version and locale. Address the locale directly; Parsequerade resolves Apple’s localization ID.

example.promotionalText: A clearer place for your ideas.
example.whatsNew: Faster search and improved offline editing.

notes: Choose versionId from the app’s version list. The adapter checks that it belongs to appId and resolves locale against that version’s localizations.
A missing locale returns 404 localization_not_found. The service does not substitute the primary locale or create a localization during a GET.
App name, subtitle, and privacy URLs belong to app-info localizations. They are separate from the version listing shown here.
